subject: Re: Request for short-term pilot voucher while PO processes
messages:
From: Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@clinixa.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clinixa.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T13:02:00-04:00
Subject: Pilot pause — procurement hold, can you bridge access?

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from our side: procurement is asking for a final PO review and legal sign-off; it looks like that will take 10–14 business days. We're mid-pilot and the team is starting to lose momentum — the NLU tests and prompt tuning are still in progress. Can Redwood provide a short-term voucher or temporary credits so we can keep the sandbox live while we finish procurement?

I've attached the draft PO and the current SOW so you can see where legal is pausing. If we can get 1–2 weeks of coverage it would keep our integrations stable and the pilot metrics intact.

Thanks,
Michael O'Neal
Director, AI Engineering
Clinixa

Attachments: Clinixa_PO_Draft.pdf (application/pdf), SOW-Clinixa-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@clinixa.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clinixa.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T13:48:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — procurement hold, can you bridge access?

Hi Michael — thanks for the heads up and for sending the drafts. Totally understand the need to keep the pilot live.

We can provision a short-term "Pilot Sustainer" voucher to bridge the account while the PO clears. Proposed terms:
- Duration: 14 days (configurable to 7/14 days)
- Value: equivalent to $6,000 of credits (covers expected token/compute usage for current test cadence)
- Conditions: voucher applies only to the pilot project; full billing will resume once PO is active.

If that works for you I can route this for internal approval now and issue a code (or provide a DocuSign acknowledgement link if procurement prefers). Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred duration (7 vs 14 days)
2) Confirm billing contact for PO reference (so we add the voucher to the right HubSpot/Deal record)

I'll loop Priyom and Laura to speed approval on our side.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T14:10:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pause — procurement hold, can you bridge access? — approval ask

Team — forwarding Clinixa's ask. Recommended: approve a 14-day Pilot Sustainer voucher valued at $6k to protect the deal health. Rationale:
- Pilot is actively driving POC outcomes; losing momentum risks extension/derisking the sale.
- Credit exposure limited and time boxed.
- We have precedence for this at the deal stage (see DEAL-4120).

If you approve I will: 1) generate voucher code and acknowledgement stub (pilot_sustainer_voucher.txt), 2) post DocuSign acknowledgement link for the customer and 3) attach voucher to HubSpot deal record.

Suggested message to customer after approval: short confirmation + redemption instructions and an ask for the PO reference number.

Thanks — Steph

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T14:40:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pause — procurement hold, can you bridge access? — approval ask

Approved. 14 days / $6k voucher is fine. Please include the following in the acknowledgement:
- PO reference field mandatory in reply (so finance can tie usage to incoming invoice)
- Expiration clause: voucher void if PO not received within 30 days

I'll update the HubSpot deal and add a note with the expected invoice flow. Steph — generate the voucher and send the DocuSign link to Michael. When you post the voucher, ping me and I'll confirm in the deal.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Sales Operations
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: pilot_sustainer_voucher.txt (text/plain)

From: Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@clinixa.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clinixa.com>, Anna Soto <anna.soto@clinixa.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T15:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — procurement hold, can you bridge access?

Stephanie / Team — this is great, thank you. We accept the 14-day voucher and the terms. We'll provide a PO reference as soon as procurement gets the final legal markup (we expect that by next week). Please send the DocuSign acknowledgement and the voucher code.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will keep our engineers focused while procurement finishes the review.

Best,
Michael
Director, AI Engineering, Clinixa
